summary: Iter8 polish-pass verification of 3 small UX fixes. ALL 3 REQUESTED FRONTEND CHECKS PASS; backend regression skipped by agreement (no backend files touched this iter). (1) SHIPPING 'USA' — On /product/prod_babd907a2e at 390x844 mobile: opened shipping-quotes -> shipping-toggle -> shipping-country. First option renders text 'USA' (not 'United States'). After selection the SelectValue trigger reads 'USA'. Intercepted POST /api/shipping/quotes payload confirms country='US' (code preserved, only display label changed). All 10 country options load. (2) MAKERWORLD ATTRIBUTION ON /tools — Authed cold-load renders data-testid='makerworld-attribution' as <a href='https://makerworld.com' target='_blank'>. Inline SVG hex logo renders (2 svg descendants: hex logo + external-link icon). Text contains 'MakerWorld' 3 times (title + chip + inline). Positioning verified via bounding rects: hero_top=162 < mw_top=290 < search_top=435 — the card sits between hero and the search/category tabs as required. Unauthed cold-load of /tools still correctly redirects to '/' and the attribution card is NOT visible unauthed. (3) LOGIN REDIRECT FIX — Intercepted click navigation on Home data-testid='tools-signin-cta' AND 'tools-register-cta': both build URL 'https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fdesign-forge-520.preview.emergentagent.com%2Ftools' (URL-decoded: origin+/tools). Fix confirmed — post-auth users now land on /tools, not /dashboard. (4) BACKEND REGRESSION — SKIPPED per review_request instruction ('49/49 known green, no backend endpoints changed this iteration'). No backend files were modified in this iter (only 3 frontend files: ShippingQuotes.jsx, Tools.jsx, Home.jsx).
critical_code_review_comments: ShippingQuotes.jsx COUNTRIES[0].name='USA' is a purely presentational change; underlying code 'US' preserved so backend contract unaffected. Clean.

Tools.jsx new makerworld-attribution anchor: uses inline SVG (no external asset dep -> no broken img risk), proper rel='noreferrer' with target='_blank' (security-safe). Sits in correct DOM position between hero and search.

Home.jsx loginWithGoogle now redirects to origin+'/tools' — resolves the iter7 advisory. Note this affects ALL callers of loginWithGoogle (both Tools-bubble CTAs). If any other CTA (e.g., generic navbar login) reuses this helper, users will always land on /tools regardless of intent. Consider parameterising: loginWithGoogle(nextPath='/tools').
Pre-existing (from iter7, not this iter): benign React '' console warnings still present in ProductCard-related components. Not fixed here, not blocking.
Iter8 code diff is minimal and focused — good polish pass.
